title: Bump opum-lore federated pin to v0.9.0
description: lore-cli tag-cut + publish handshake for LCLI-469: v0.9.0 adds a generator stamp to committed schemas (LCLI-565), which makes every existing schema exit-6 stale until `lore schema export` regenerates them in the same PR. Bump marketplace.json's opum-lore ref and federated-pin-baselines.json's opum-lore entry (ref, trees.skills, verifiedAt, note) together in one commit, per this repo's established federated-pin playbook.

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm dist-tags.latest independently confirmed as 0.9.0 for @opum-ai/lore and all 6 platform packages (not taken from lore-cli's message)
Tag chain (v0.9.0 ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills/ subtree) independently re-resolved via the GitHub API and recorded in federated-pin-baselines.json's note
lore@0.9.0 installed locally; lore schema export run to clear generator-stamp staleness; lore check exits 0 locally with 0.9.0 installed before trusting CI
scripts/check-federated-content.mjs passes locally against the bumped pin + baseline
marketplace.json ref and federated-pin-baselines.json (ref, trees.skills, verifiedAt, note) moved together in the same commit
Required checks green on the PR's head SHA; task closed (acceptance criteria + final summary) inside that same PR before merge

finalSummary: Bumped opum-lore federated pin v0.8.0 -> v0.9.0 (lore-cli LCLI-469 handshake). Independently re-verified rather than taken on trust: npm dist-tags.latest = 0.9.0 on the main package and all 6 platform packages; tag chain (ref -> tag object 48840cb3... -> commit fd712748... -> root tree -> skills/ subtree 38683e10...) matches lore-cli's claimed SHAs exactly, cross-checked via both the GitHub API and git ls-remote. v0.9.0 stamps committed schemas with a generator digest (LCLI-565), which made every committed schema exit-6 stale; regenerated all 8 via lore schema export with 0.9.0 installed locally (including a new arc.schema.json from LCLI-554's Story->Arc rename) in the same commit as the pin bump. Both lore check and scripts/check-federated-content.mjs pass clean locally. PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#139 green on all three required checks (lore check, check . manifests, Tracker integrity), CI run 35795975722. Additionally proved the gate both directions per opum-agent's OPAG-326 request: draft PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#140, stacked on #139 with story.schema.json deliberately reverted to its pre-export stale content, failed lore check (run 35796013289, exit 6) with exactly one schema-drift error and both other required jobs green -- closed unmerged.
